title: Field protocol v1 record event (Field to core)
description: One collected source object as a normalized source envelope: post-mapping and pre-serialization. The Field has already mapped vendor structures onto A1 vocabulary; core still owns record IDs, producer provenance, canonical bytes, key ordering, filenames, hashes, capture time, projections, and every durable write. A record is never a rendered Note and never carries a notebook path. 'change' selects an upsert of current state or an explicit authoritative deletion.

object_kind.description: The capability slice this record belongs to. Must be a kind the manifest declared.

properties.description: Flat property candidates keyed by A1 property names: unprefixed properties from the closed A1 shared registry, plus connector-prefixed properties this Field's manifest declared. Core-owned and hoisted names are structurally excluded here. Core still validates every name, type, prefix ownership, and list semantics against the A1 registry and the declaring manifest.

body.description: Deterministically normalized source evidence for the Note body, as source text rather than a model summary. Core applies the A1 body normalization and computes the content hash; a Field never supplies a content hash.

artifacts.description: Original bytes carried by this record, in role order. Core derives the A1 'attachments' list from the members with role 'attachment', preserving this order, and the set-like 'artifacts' list from all members.

identity_anchors.description: Person, account, organization, or artifact anchors this record supplies. Anchors may relate graph entities. They are never part of the portable exact-source key and core never reconciles Notes by them.

integrity.description: Known content loss for this record, projected by core onto the A1 damage properties.

authority.description: Deletion authority. Present only on a delete. 'tombstone' requires the manifest to declare authoritative tombstones; core rejects the record otherwise. Absence of an object is never expressed as a delete record.

observed_at.description: When the Field observed the authoritative deletion. Present only on a delete.

allOf.description: An upsert carries mapped current state and no deletion authority.
A delete carries only the portable source key, its authority, and when it was observed. It never carries content, so a deletion can never be confused with an empty or partial collection result.

kind.description: 'staged' means the Field wrote the exact original bytes into the run's staging directory under 'handle'. 'digest_only' means the Field knows the artifact by digest and did not transfer bytes; core accepts it only when it already stores that digest, and otherwise rejects the record so the Field retries with bytes.

sha256.description: The Field's declared SHA-256 over the exact original bytes. Core always computes its own digest over staged bytes and derives the A1 artifact ID from that; a disagreement rejects the record. Required for 'digest_only', where it is the only thing core has to match against bytes it already stores.

role.description: 'attachment' maps into the A1 role-ordered attachments list. 'original' is the source object's own bytes. Every role also appears in the set-like artifacts list.

source_filename.description: Display metadata only. Never a path component and never the stored extension: core derives both the notebook path and the canonical extension itself.
